theme.description: Style 'Clair et doux' inspiré du concept Dribbble : fond chaud et doux (teinte lin/ivoire subtile #F8F9FA / #F4F6F8), grandes cartes blanches nettes avec bords arrondis (rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl), ombres diffuses ultra-douces, bordures 1px délicates, typographie hiérarchisée et accents pastel raffinés (émeraude sauge pour les revenus/positif, corail doux pour les dépenses, bleu ardoise pour les virements, ambre doré pour les alertes/épargne).

rules.kpi_numbers: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 font-sans tabular-nums
rules.card_headers: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-slate-700 tracking-wide uppercase text-xs text-slate-500

entry_surfaces./: dashboard layout: sticky clean light top-bar/sidebar, large rounded white KPI cards grid, central visual analytics charts, and transaction/recurring split feeds

layout_and_grids.app_shell: Flex layout with responsive collapsible sidebar (or bottom nav on mobile / tabs) + top header filter bar with account selector, pocket/enveloppe selector, year selector, and 'Inclure les virements internes' toggle.
layout_and_grids.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6
layout_and_grids.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 with left 8-cols for monthly trend chart + category breakdown donut, and right 4-cols for top categories and upcoming recurring items
layout_and_grids.card_styling: bg-white rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl border border-slate-100/80 shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)] p-5 sm:p-6 transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_-4px_rgba(15,23,42,0.08)]
layout_and_grids.table_styling: w-full border-collapse text-left rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-sm border border-slate-100

header_filters.description: Global filter bar with Account select, Pocket/Enveloppe select, Year select (2024, 2025, 2026), and Switch 'Inclure les virements internes', + quick Add Transaction action.

kpi_summary_cards.description: 4 large distinct cards: Solde total consolidé (with expandable per-account pill breakdown), Revenus de l'année, Dépenses de l'année, Solde net annuel + Ce mois-ci sub-stat.

monthly_charts.description: Recharts interactive Bar + Line chart comparing monthly Revenus, Dépenses and Net with toggleable curves and custom clean Tooltip formatted in €.

category_donut_and_top.description: Donut chart with expense distribution and adjacent Top categories list (highlighting top 4 with progress bars and badges).

operations_table.description: Searchable, sortable, filterable operations view (search query, category filter, account filter, type filter, status filter) with bulk actions, CSV export/import, source badges (manuel/importé/récurrence), categorisation status (auto/manuelle/à vérifier), and add/edit/duplicate/delete dialogs.

annual_analysis.description: Page 'Le fil de l'année mois après mois' : summary cards, month-by-month bar chart, cumulative balance curve, category stacked bars, monthly detail table with deficit months highlighted in soft red, and previous year comparison metrics.

savings_tracker.description: Page Épargne : Real savings total, allocated vs unallocated amount, savings goals cards with progress bars and target dates, allocate/split/deallocate modal dialogs, and over-allocation alert badge.

recurring_manager.description: Page Récurrences : List of regular bills and subscriptions with frequency, next execution date, amount, pause/stop toggles, and add/edit recurring modal.

rules_engine.description: Page Règles : Ordered priority categorization rules with multiple conditions (contains, amount greater than, account equals), enable/disable toggle, drag/order reordering buttons, and 'Tester la règle' simulation sandbox.

data_manager.description: Page Données : CSV Import wizard with automatic delimiter detection, column mapping (Date, Libellé, Montant, Compte, Catégorie), live preview table, duplicate detection, JSON full database export/import, and factory reset with safety confirmation dialog.

indexeddb_architecture.engine: Local in-browser IndexedDB with idb / native wrapper (no remote backend needed for persistence, 100% private and offline)
indexeddb_architecture.initial_seed: Automatic rich seed with realistic French personal finance data for 2025 & 2026 (Comptes: Compte Courant BNP, Livret A, Compte BoursoBank, Carte Débit; ~80+ categorized operations, 6 recurring items, 4 savings goals, 5 smart rules) so the app opens fully populated and vibrant on first load.

motion.card_entrance: Fade-in with subtle translateY(6px), stagger duration 0.05s
motion.chart_animations: Smooth Recharts animationDuration={800} on mount and filter changes
motion.micro_interactions: hover:scale-[1.01] on cards, active:scale-[0.98] on buttons, smooth tab and accordion transitions
motion.dialogs: Smooth backdrop blur with scale-in animation

accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab order across filters, buttons, dialogs, and table rows
accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit aria-label on all icon-only buttons, currency inputs, and filter toggles
accessibility.contrast_compliance: All text tokens strictly maintain >= 4.5:1 contrast against light cards and backgrounds
accessibility.data_testids: Strict implementation of data-testid attributes on all interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep all data local in browser via IndexedDB with pre-populated rich French dummy data so Tableau de bord, Opérations, Analyse annuelle, Épargne, Récurrences, and Règles look alive immediately.
2. Ensure the currency format is consistently French (€ at end: e.g. 1 250,50 € or +450,00 € / -32,90 €). Use Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }).
3. Date format must be French (DD/MM/YYYY or DD MMM YYYY, e.g. '14 mars 2026').

4. Follow the Dribbble-inspired aesthetic 'Clair et doux': large rounded white cards (rounded-2xl / rounded-3xl), soft shadow (shadow-[0_4px_20px_-4px_rgba(15,23,42,0.05)]), subtle borders (border-slate-100), and pastel tinted KPI badges.
5. For Recharts: use responsive containers with clean custom tooltips with rounded-xl border and white background. Avoid cluttered axis lines, use strokeDasharray='3 3' on soft slate grids.
6. Include the 6 main tabs/pages in navigation: 'Tableau de bord', 'Opérations', 'Analyse annuelle', 'Épargne', 'Récurrences', 'Règles', 'Données'.

7. Include comprehensive data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, table rows, cards, and modal triggers (e.g. data-testid='kpi-revenus-card', data-testid='add-transaction-button', data-testid='filter-account-select', etc.).
